Two verification scripts replayed successfully, one symbolic-integral and one finite-field row reduction. Finite fields have trivial Brauer group, establishing contraction-to-plane count. All quantified characteristics included; 3 excluded.

value.rationale: Rational sixer classes count plane blow-downs of a smooth cubic, while rational double-sixes with exchanged halves mark an arithmetic descent obstruction. The complete 2 versus 72 and 4 versus 36 classifications, three non-split half cases, and all-extension zeta functions are natural finite-étale arithmetic invariants, not arbitrary slices. Counts are not implied by the known number of individually rational lines or geometric automorphism orbit decomposition.
